name: @dzhi/oomph
description: Minimal self-hosted web UI for the omp coding agent

scripts.build: bunx @tailwindcss/cli -i client/index.css -o dist/app.css --minify && bun build client/main.tsx --outfile dist/app.js --minify --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --define BUILD_STAMP="\"$(date '+%F %H:%M')\""
scripts.check: biome ci --error-on-warnings . && tsc --noEmit -p . && bun run build && bun test

host.description: 127.0.0.1: this machine only (use a reverse proxy/tunnel to expose it). 0.0.0.0: every interface (LAN, VPN); plain HTTP unless you put TLS in front

autostart.description: Start the server with each interactive omp; it stops when the last one closes
